about.title: about me
about.intro: React and Next.js are my home turf — {years} years in, start to finish. Mechatronics came first, which probably explains my obsession with how the pieces fit.

experience.description: Built the MVP for a financial app in React and Next.js — responsive, scalable, and it shipped. Remote, Stockholm.
Drove the React front-end of a job search platform, plus tooling for technical staff and content teams.
Front-end across the whole stack of the era: WordPress, jQuery, React, Vue, Twig. Scrum, solid team, plenty shipped.

education.description: The second round of mechatronics. Left it unfinished — the web was more fun.
My first engineering degree. Where it all started.
